_comment: Mirrors Umbraco Cloud production specs as of 2026-05. App Service is dedicated per-tier with different P-series SKUs - Cloud differentiates plans via dedicated SKUs (corrected by Mikulas; the previous shared-P1V3 model was wrong). SQL is Standard-tier Elastic Pools with per-DB DTU caps. DB size is not enforced. Exact tier-to-SKU + DTU mapping is a best-guess pending confirmation; adjust here if Cloud's real mapping differs.
